mushroom_basket.name: Mushrooms to eat
mushroom_basket.description: A basket of mushrooms on a pillar. Each of six kinds carries one of the camera glitch study's pixel operations; eaten (held to the mouth, or the trigger / left click while held), it puts that operation into the visitor's own eyes for about half a minute. Eaten mushrooms grow back.
mushroom_basket.qfep_connection: The camera study shows the errors a record can be read with; here the same errors are in the visitor's own reading of the room. Perception is an operation, and it can be changed by what is taken in.
